fold_assignment: fixed H calendar two-day folds; ±1 BJT-day train gap
normalization_scope: arm-specific per-pixel log1p(COT), training-fold rows only, common two-endpoint daylight support
cot_input: endpoint3 uses target-time P-XC COT; interval3 uses arithmetic mean of preceding and target endpoint COT, with historical R_U COT at +15 only
spatial_encoding: same 16x16 CNN head as fullpatch H-CV; only center 3x3 positions populated
